newsitem.title: USA: CTX Intl launches new notebook computer, monitor.
newsitem.headline: CTX Intl launches new notebook computer, monitor.

text.p: Taiwan-based privately-held CTX International Tuesday introduced a new notebook computer and a new flat panel monitor.

The notebook computer, the EzBook 764MT-MK, has an Intel MMX 166 MHz Pentium processor supported by 256K of Level 2 cache memory and 40 MB of RAM, the company said Tuesday. It measures 11.69 by 8.97 by 1.88 inches and weighs 6.6 lbs. Its suggested retail price is $3,569.

CTX also introduced the PanoView 745, a 14.5-inch liquid chrystal display flat panel monitor with a suggested retail price of $2,795. The monitor is 15.2 inches high, 15 inches wide and 10.1 inches deep and weighs 11 lbs. It has two 1-watt internal speakers and a 3-watt amplifier.
